source.title: MarketSmith HK：Minervini趋势模型
source.applicability: Source explicitly provides A-share template examples and ratings; not evidence of A-share profitability

universe: Only Shanghai and Shenzhen A-share common stocks. No ETF, fund, B-share, HK, BJ or indices.

rule_conditions.source_wording: MA200 upward trend for at least120 days
rule_conditions.limitation: Endpoint rise does not prove every intervening slope positive; do not claim exact commercial implementation

rs_proxy_recommendation.input: adjusted close(t)/adjusted close(t-252 trading sessions)-1; fixed-session approximation to12months
rs_proxy_recommendation.universe: All in-scope, non-excludedSH/SZcodes with253completepositiveOHLCV observations before applying trend conditions; disclose exclusion and missing counts
rs_proxy_recommendation.rank: average ties; ascending rank amongN; 1+98*(rank-1)/(N-1); singleton neutral50, not99
rs_proxy_recommendation.limitations: Proprietary weighting and rounding not reproduced. Not RSI, probability, winrate or expected return.

display_order_recommendation: security_code asc within ties for display only
holding_display: 模板未规定固定持有期；需结合入场形态与退出计划
public_source_license: No redistribution license established. Link and paraphrase public facts; do not package full article or protected charts.
